title: AITA for laughing during communion?
question: AITA for laughing during communion?
body:
I went to a Catholic mass for the first time with a few friends yesterday. Everything was going fine, I was just following along with them, then everyone stood up And got in a line. I did the same thing, just following everybody else. 

I saw everyone drinking from the same cup, and knew one friend was having an internal cringe fest (super germaphobe), and it hit my giggle switch, but I held it in. Then my friend directly in front of me (the one who is actually catholic) gets there, and the priest tells her to hold out her hand instead of putting the wafer in her mouth like he had done with everyone else. I am composed, I am not laughing, but I’m fighting it hard. We get back, and friend Why wouldn’t he put it in my mouth?” I snorted!!! God bless, I snorted at mass, and had to walk out because when I get embarrassed I laugh harder. The people on their way out shot daggers with their eyes, but while trying to look ashamed, I just kept getting fits of the giggles. AITA?
